scope: Independent adversarial core tests and finite-control/source correspondence for opt-in structured acquisition/exposure and owned retained projection reads.
reviewed_claims: Version2 requires operator-owned baseline/source selections pinned to namespace identity; version1 retains its closed configuration and historical semantics.

Complete original policy closure is conjoined over host exposure, including empty or narrower worker-declared lineage; actual 35-node ancestry tests reject the restrictive late ancestor rather than truncating at32.
Closure over64 or representation/decision over65536 denies without inventing a separate HOLD record or erasing a known completion.
Frozen parallel input contexts remain immutable while recipient exposure grows monotonically before reply.
Pending acquisition and executing state are atomic before execute; unknown work is not redispatched.
Observed known completion is retained independently of current payload, inspection, lineage and delivery availability.
Registered source policies govern real descriptor and result processing before the detector or external execute callback.
Original source expiry and identity survive replay and grant renewal; source construction within journal transactions is pure.
Native and cached payload delivery uses current recipient policy union, independent of descriptor/input admissibility.
Owned effect/source reads use complete current task exposure plus original selected ancestry; pending acquisition blocks older views.
Selected source provenance is separate from current task admission; discarded raw originals are not reconstructed or fetched.
Readers acquire no execution owner lock, perform no recovery/redispatch and use coherent read-only SQLite snapshots released before callbacks.
All final callbacks precede pure namespace/context/pending/expiry checks. These define admission snapshots, with later authority/exposure/expiry changes possible before I/O.

Version2 CLI wrappers rely on the exact ingress AuthenticationLease already checked inside the core, avoiding another authentication callback after the final pure context check; version1 retained-effect post-check is preserved.

findings_and_repairs.finding: Policy references, parents and original expiry require integrity independent of the projection commitment. Missing associations must not become an empty scope.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Whole immutable source body determines keyed source identity; sealed context/invocation manifests bind complete closure, frontier, count and pending membership. Exact step/kind/actor/payload mapping is checked.

findings_and_repairs.finding: An acquisition callback could issue native work before reporting its acquired source. A pending/prepared transaction gap could also strand resumable work.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Pending obligation, manifest and executing transition commit atomically before execute; rollback leaves prepared without pending. Pending blocks new work/reads and persists for unknown after restart.

findings_and_repairs.finding: Registered and inherited source processing policies must precede detector callbacks; descriptor admissibility alone cannot authorise processing.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Inspect boundary receives full inherited/registered policy scope before callback and rechecks current authorisation afterward.

findings_and_repairs.finding: Draft payload view omitted completed/available discriminants, skipping shared payload schema and inspection-receipt validation.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Supply the exact discriminants and run existing validate_payload; malformed stored inspection receipt withholds the projection without erasing completion.

findings_and_repairs.finding: Current grant renewal during acquisition must not extend the original source admission expiry.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Capture admitted expiry before journal lock; pending freezes it; completion and replay retain original minimum across policy/grant/ancestor expiry.

findings_and_repairs.finding: Cached delivery retained the journal guard across final scanner checks; source constructors also consulted current authority within transactions.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Release journal guards before all session/current/inspection callbacks. In-transaction source/pending constructors use pure MAC, immutable templates and pre-admitted expiry; locked context equality rejects callback-driven growth before execute.

findings_and_repairs.finding: Post-callback union authorised a small status marker but could omit authorisation of the separately delivered larger payload.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Rebind both same inspected payload and status under full current union, then pure namespace/context/pending/expiry verification after final callbacks.

findings_and_repairs.finding: Reply checks used only retained source ancestry and could miss restrictions already accumulated by the recipient, despite a permitted descriptor or frozen child input.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Authorise source plus full recipient union before inspection; expose before reply; final no-scan payload admission and pure unchanged-context/expiry check follow callbacks.

findings_and_repairs.finding: Selecting an earlier baseline effect/source could bypass a later restriction or pending acquisition on the same owned task.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Version2 policy scope conjoins full parent exposure with selected ancestry; selected-source lineage remains exact provenance. All metadata/available returns verify a final pure ReadBinding and expiry; version1 remains unchanged.

findings_and_repairs.finding: Native ACK needed explicit consistency between stored completion and step output/evidence before trusted receipt use.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Existing validate_completion checks exact effect/settlement/certainty/disposition/output against retained step before v2 ACK admission.

findings_and_repairs.finding: Early replay expiry and source-binding mutations did not alter the actual admission mechanism; Unknown call count and several witnesses could be too weak.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Mutate real cached guard/binding branch; compare Unknown retry count to captured pre-crash count; require live policy-specific witnesses and actual cached return. Add explicit child target and full recipient reply gates, atomic pending commit, rollback, and separate final snapshot/reply I/O.

earlier_observations.limitation: Exploratory run; compilation overlapped lineage/exposure_authorization extraction. Predates late recipient/read/ACK changes and cycle variant. Not a final-source gate.
Both exact cached/native recipient regressions passed before later public-reader and ACK refinements; not the final20 source-bound gate.
Explicitly superseded intermediate runtime cut; predates final20/public-reader/ACK refinements. No final-source claim.

anti_vacuity: Identical acquisition using baseline-only source policy permits the same downstream action.
Late-ancestor test compares restricted and baseline-only actual chains.
Cached payload is positively returned before later source restriction; its descriptor remains admissible afterward.
Same child reply is positively delivered before later recipient restriction; frozen sibling input remains admissible.
Both older public views are available before later pending/restriction.
independent_core_tests.cycle_test_limit: Self-cycle metadata edit under unchanged keyed identity demonstrates fail-closed authenticated corruption; it is not a valid-MAC arbitrary-cycle construction proof.

final_focused_run.binding: Core and owned20 test hashes match this receipt before and after the reported frozen-source run. Subsequent CLI-only cleanup is reviewed separately; parent full final-source gate remains required.

reader_auxiliary_run.scope: Exact source shape/read-only restart, absent/unfinished uncertainty, withheld certainty and callback-growth payload-versus-status admission.

focused_run.replay_check: Independently read all36 replay records: exit0,35 intended assertion violations and one START OF CYCLE; commands retained.

accepted_mapping: Complete closure classes and late33 traversal
Frozen parallel child inputs and current inherited child targets
Atomic pending+Executing and failed transaction retry
Blocked nested work and Unknown retries
Known completion retained on inspection/source failure
Recipient exposure before reply and final full-recipient payload admission
Separate final snapshot and subsequent reply I/O
limits: Finite control abstraction, not a refinement proof of Rust, SQLite, cryptography, schemas, detectors, arbitrary DAGs or semantic information flow.
Closure classes Basic/Late33/Missing/Cycle/Conflict/Oversize abstract actual graph topology and MAC validation; exact65536-byte policy/encoding bounds are implementation checks.
One parent, two children, one acquisition, one downstream action, one authority-or-time update, one crash, one rollback/prepared retry and one cached retry.
File authority and final recipient exposure checks are snapshots; no linearisation with later I/O or sibling growth.
Same-invocation descriptor callback growth is guarded by a reviewed locked source-ID/frontier comparison; no executed named regression is claimed for that specific branch.
Retained-effect coherent snapshot/current whole-view abstraction and exposure model are separate; no joint arbitrary readergraph refinement proof.

parent_full_validation.required_binding: Parent final validation must bind the accepted source hashes/final commit to completed implementation, HTTP/example, acceptance/provider and default formal gates. Historical test results cannot substitute for changed-source checks.

E3: Larger and shared multi-principal/subscriber ancestry/readership qualification
Exact original-source bytes and detector assessment custody/adjudication
Protected revision and any authorised declassification/retention/deletion/restore profile
N2: Remaining acquisition/inference/revision and managed/shared deployment boundaries
N3: Authorised exact assessment/source resolution for adjudication beyond retained projection
Durable queue/timed retry/escalation and provider reconciliation
Shared case ownership and endpoint/deployment qualification
trust_limits: Trusted local storage/configuration/native-worker profile; source seals do not provide whole-database anti-rollback or worker isolation.
Deterministic fixture inspection establishes conformance, not neural detector quality, external collector behavior or deployment capacity.
No whole-plan completion claim; governed revision remains unsupported and inference restrictions stay enforced.
Unavailable or withheld reads confer no execution/retry authority; total configured query-inspector outage can deny retained fact readability without deleting those facts.

changes: retained_source returns after core ReadBinding verification without a later principal.current callback.
retained_effect retains the historical post-current check for version1 and skips it only for version2.
execute version2 output-admission closure returns after read_governed_root_delivery without a later caller.current callback.
lease_correspondence: GovernedIngress::authenticate clones the exact AuthenticationLease record, authentication-file path, export set and commitment-key identity into session.with_authentication_check before inspector attachment.
GovernedSession::current invokes that lease callback before authority reads; result/core final current checks precede pure context/expiry verification.
AuthenticationLease::check rejects changed key identity or missing/different exact active credential record.
Owned task/principal/actor/fingerprint checks still precede run path selection; removing the redundant post-core callback does not grant another identity or bypass the core lease.
cli_final_cleanup_review.validation_limit: No tests rerun for this cleanup review. Root final workspace/example/HTTP gates must bind the final CLI binary; direct N3 results on an earlier host remain intermediate.
